Name: Skirt for Male or Female Farmer and Round Face for Males
Author: HyperChicken01
Description:
[size=2][i]'I originally uploaded this to the Stardew Valley Forums, I decided to post it up here for anyone else, who doesn't have an account there or prefers this site.'[/i]


I saw that there were others who wanted this and I thought I would give it a go. This is my first time attempting something like this and honestly I think it turned out better than I expected. It's not perfect, but I may as well have been going in completely blind. [i]If anyone has seen the contents of the edited .xnb you'll understand what I mean.
[/i]
The following animations I have tested are:

- Walking
- Running
- Using basic axe/hoe/pick axe
- Using watering can
- Using sickle/sword

I have not tested out the more uncommon animations, like shock/fear, etc. but I believe they should hopefully work without any issues.

I haven't played much of the game (About 5hrs). So, any other animations or sprites that may appear later in the game I am unable to test in-game as of yet.

I was already doing this for myself because I wanted to make my character, 'Adult Malon' from LoZ:OoT. But, since others have requested it, I thought I may as well post it up here for everyone.

If anyone discovers something that looks broken, please let me know and I'll try my best to fix it.


[u]
Installation:[/u]

Navigate to your Stardew Valley Installation folder and copy file/s to:
Content/Characters/Farmer

Don't forget to make a backup of the original .xnb file/s before overwriting


I hope you all like it![/size]
